source.note: P-6 makes no remote call. Pillar names are the NUS GE curriculum's (AY2021/22 on: GEA, GEC, GEI, GEN, GES/GESS, GEX) and the earlier pillars still offered (GEH, GEQ, GET); each prefix and its modules' titles were checked against the pinned corpus. 3B-0 confirms the URL and names, and any change goes through the lead.

rules: a generic phrase maps to every prefix in `prefixes`; a pillar name maps to its own prefixes; several in one query take the union
matched at parse step 7, with the 3D phrases, on tokens no join consumed
interpreted.ge echoes the sorted prefixes; ignore=ge undoes it
a bare pillar prefix (`GEX`, `gess`) is a partial code (interpreted.prefix), not the GE intent
